title: NCL Mining Sirdar T&S Gr. C — Mock 15
pattern: NCL Mining Sirdar CBT (100 Q · 100 marks · 90 min · no -ve)

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, 'Owner' includes
options: The person who owns the machinery of the mine
The person who carries out the blasting
The person who has ultimate control over the mine including lessee
The persons engaged in the actual mining work
questions.solution: Owner includes any person having ultimate control over the mine, including lessees.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Stripping ratio' is
questions.solution: Overburden per unit coal.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Mine reclamation planning should begin at the
questions.solution: Reclamation should be integrated into mine planning from the design stage itself.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Landform Design' for reclaimed mine areas must consider
options: Drainage patterns, stability, and compatibility with intended use
The outward shape of the final landform
The total extent of the reclaimed area
The colour of the final surface material
questions.solution: Landform design considers drainage, stability, and use compatibility.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'peer review' of a report involves
options: The typist who types the report
The author who wrote the report
Review by colleagues to check accuracy and quality
The printer who prints the report
questions.solution: Peer review involves colleague review for accuracy and quality assurance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Biodiversity Assessment' on reclaimed mine land evaluates
options: The total number of trees planted
The number of seed bags used for sowing
Species diversity, abundance, and ecosystem function
The number of fence posts erected
questions.solution: Assessment evaluates diversity, abundance, and ecosystem function.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Mines Rules 1955, the 'Welfare Officer' is appointed for
options: All the mines in the country
questions.solution: Welfare Officers must be appointed for mines with more than 500 workers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'recommendation' in a report should be
options: Specific, actionable, and based on evidence
Vague and without any clear direction
General and not supported by facts
questions.solution: Recommendations should be specific, actionable, and supported by evidence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, a 'day' means
options: Calendar day from midnight to midnight
questions.solution: Under the Mines Act, 'day' means the period from midnight to midnight.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Rescue Practice frequency is
options: At least eight times a year (gap not exceeding four months between consecutive practices)
Never at any point of service
questions.solution: Mines Rescue Rules 1985 Rule 21(2) read with Schedule VII Part II: at least 8 practices per year with no gap exceeding 4 months.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'inter-ramp angle' is measured between
options: Crest of one bench and toe of the next below
questions.solution: Between crest of one bench and toe of next below.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Blasting Safety Zone' radius depends on
options: Fixed at 100 meters for all blasts
The type and quantity of explosives used
questions.solution: Blasting safety zone radius depends on explosive type and quantity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Duty Doctor' at mines under Mines Rules 1955 must be available
questions.solution: Duty doctors must be available during all working shifts for medical emergencies.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Traffic Management Plan' for opencast mines must cover
options: All mine roads, intersections, and work areas
questions.solution: Traffic management must cover all roads and work areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Hazard reporting is duty of
options: All persons who become aware of hazards
questions.solution: All persons.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, 'Welfare' includes
options: Provision of amenities for health, hygiene, and comfort of workers
The amount of salary paid to the mine workers
The bonus paid to workers at the festival time
The canteen subsidy given to the mine workers
questions.solution: Welfare includes amenities for health, hygiene, and worker comfort.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Blast geometry includes
questions.solution: Burden, spacing, diameter, depth, sub-drill.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Pedestrian Safety' measures at opencast mines include
options: Designated walkways, barriers, and visibility measures
questions.solution: Pedestrian safety requires designated walkways and visibility.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Cushion blasting' protects
questions.solution: Protects the final wall from damage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Rest shelters are at
options: Intervals along haul roads and faces
questions.solution: Along roads and faces.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Pit crest' is the
questions.solution: Top edge of bench face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Critical burden is maximum burden at which
options: Explosive can still break rock to free face
questions.solution: Explosive can still break rock.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Explosive factor in opencast is
options: Weight of explosive per unit volume of rock broken
questions.solution: Weight per unit volume of rock.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Tyre management is important because
options: Tyres are expensive and affect safety
questions.solution: Tyres are expensive and affect safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'haul ramp' provides
questions.solution: Access between benches for equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'executive briefing' differs from a full report by being
options: Exactly the same as the full report in every way
Much longer than the full technical report
More detailed than the full technical report
Shorter, focusing on key findings and recommendations for decision-makers
questions.solution: Executive briefings are concise summaries for decision-makers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'velocity of detonation' (VOD) of emulsion explosives is typically
questions.solution: Emulsion explosives typically have higher VOD than ANFO, providing better fragmentation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Sirdar duties include
options: Paying the wages of the workers
Counting the tools of the mine
questions.solution: Supervising, safety, reporting.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An equipment breakdown report should include
options: Nature of breakdown, probable cause, repair actions, and downtime
The amount shown in the monthly fuel bills
The address of the workshop where it was taken
questions.solution: Breakdown reports must document the nature, cause, repairs, and downtime impact.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Mines Act 1952 provides for
options: Health, safety, and welfare of mine workers
The profits of the mining company
The share prices of the company
questions.solution: Health, safety, welfare.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Constructed wetlands for mine water treatment use
options: The aeration tanks of the plant
Natural biological processes to treat contaminated water
questions.solution: Constructed wetlands use natural biological processes for mine water treatment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Coal loading' from bench face is done by
options: Shovel, excavator, or FEL into dumpers
questions.solution: By shovel, excavator, or FEL into dumpers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Phytoremediation in mine reclamation refers to
options: Using plants to remove contaminants from soil
questions.solution: Phytoremediation uses specific plants to extract or stabilize contaminants in mine soils.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'table of contents' in a report is important for
options: Helping readers quickly locate specific sections
questions.solution: A table of contents helps readers navigate and locate specific sections.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Compacted haul roads in reclaimed areas should be
options: Scarified and loosened before topsoil application
questions.solution: Scarifying compacted surfaces improves soil porosity and root penetration for revegetation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Emergency Response Equipment' in mines must be
options: Available, maintained, and accessible at all times
questions.solution: Emergency equipment must be available and maintained at all times.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Blast vibration is controlled by
options: Delay timing, charge per delay, distance
questions.solution: Timing, charge per delay, distance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A person re-employed after an absence exceeding one year from mining work must undergo refresher training within:
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 10: refresher training within 1 month of re-employment after absence over 1 year.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Mines Rules 1955, 'Stationary Plant' includes
options: Fixed machinery and equipment at one location
The portable tools carried by the workers
The vehicles plying in the mine
questions.solution: Stationary plant refers to fixed machinery and equipment at a single location.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Canteen committee under Rules includes
options: The cook of the mine canteen
The manager of the mine himself
The cashier of the mine canteen
questions.solution: Management and workers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Fatal accident reporting under Mines Act is within
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 8(1): forthwith telephonic intimation to the Regional Inspector and written notice within 24 hours to the District Magistrate, Chief Inspector and Regional Inspector.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'final highwall' in opencast mining is left at
options: Any angle that suits the site
The stable angle of repose for the material
Vertical like the wall of a building
questions.solution: Final highwalls are left at the stable angle of repose for long-term stability.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Notice of Opening goes to
questions.solution: Chief Inspector and State Government.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Mines Rules 1955 requires that the 'Examination Board' for competency certificates include
options: The police officers of the district
The doctors of the nearby hospitals
The teachers of the local schools
Representatives of government, mine owners, and workers
questions.solution: Examination Boards must include representatives from government, owners, and workers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Safety Meeting Minutes' in mines must be
options: Given by word of mouth to the workers
Documented and distributed to all attendees
questions.solution: Meeting minutes must be documented and distributed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Blast yield is
options: The time taken for the blast
Total production from a single blast
questions.solution: Total production from one blast.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: CMR 2017 specifies air quantity per person as
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 153(2)(a): not less than 6 m3/min of air per person employed on the largest shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, 'Overburden' means
options: The soil and rock strata overlying the mineral deposit
questions.solution: Overburden is defined as the soil and rock strata overlying the mineral deposit.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'competency framework' for mine safety includes
options: Defined skills, knowledge, and experience for safety-critical roles
questions.solution: Competency frameworks define required skills and knowledge for safety-critical positions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Environmental Monitoring Report covers
options: The weather conditions of the day
The attendance of the workers of the mine
Air quality, water quality, noise, dust levels
The menu of the mine canteen
questions.solution: Air, water, noise, dust.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'topsoil management plan' should address
options: The colour of the topsoil material
The total weight of the stored soil
Stripping, storage, handling, and placement procedures
The price of the land in the area
questions.solution: Topsoil management covers stripping, storage, handling, and placement.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Spoil bank reclamation involves
questions.solution: Reshaping, covering, revegetating.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Roof supports must be
questions.solution: Provided and maintained.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'audience analysis' before writing a report involves
options: Understanding readers' knowledge level and needs
questions.solution: Audience analysis ensures the report is tailored to readers' knowledge and needs.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Haul road turning radius should be
questions.solution: 3x vehicle turning radius.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Safety signs under Rules must be
questions.solution: Visible, legible, multilingual.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'safety emergency response plan' must include
options: Evacuation, communication, medical response, and recovery procedures
questions.solution: Emergency plans must cover evacuation, communication, medical response, and recovery.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Contour reclamation is suitable for
questions.solution: Contour reclamation follows the natural contours of hilly terrain to prevent erosion and stabilize slopes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per MVTR 1966, refresher vocational training must be given to persons employed in mines at least once in:
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 8: refresher training at least once in every 5 years.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Delay detonators sequence charges for
questions.solution: Controlled fragmentation and reduced vibration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Rescue equipment storage must be
options: Any convenient location in the mine
Locked away in the store room
questions.solution: Accessible and maintained.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Side casting' means
questions.solution: Throwing overburden to the side.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: VOD indicates
questions.solution: Shattering power of the explosive.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Regulation 120 of CMR 2017 deals with
options: Protective work before a mine is closed
questions.solution: Regulation 120 of CMR 2017 deals with protective work before a mine is closed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Safety Feedback Mechanism' in mines must be
questions.solution: Feedback mechanisms must be accessible, responsive, and safe.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Safety training frequency is
questions.solution: Induction and periodically.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'transitional phrase' in reports helps to
options: Fill the blank spaces of the page
Connect ideas and ensure smooth flow between sections
Decorate the text of the report
questions.solution: Transitions connect ideas for smooth, logical flow.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Near-miss reporting in safety management is important because
options: It helps prevent future accidents by identifying precursors
questions.solution: Near-miss reports identify potential accident precursors, enabling preventive action.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)

questions.stem: Annual medical examination is for

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A can complete a work in 20 days, B in 30 days. A works alone for 5 days, then B joins. Time taken to finish remaining work is
questions.solution: A does 5/20 = 1/4 of the work in 5 days, leaving 3/4. Combined rate = 1/20 + 1/30 = 1/12 per day. Time for the remaining work = (3/4)/(1/12) = 9 days.
